end.summary:
Practised ordering BCE and CE dates on a timeline.
Discussed that larger BCE numbers are earlier, while CE dates increase to the right.
Worked through century examples including 450 CE, 1200 CE, and 1857 CE.
Aarav repeatedly requested a drawn number line and chart; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised placing BCE and CE dates in order and identifying centuries from examples. Aarav clearly stated that 700 BCE comes before 300 BCE and that 500 CE comes before 1947 CE. They asked several times to see a complete drawn timeline, so this visual support was not yet provided or checked again. At home, draw a line with 100 BCE, 1 BCE, 1 CE, 500 CE, and 1947 CE, then ask Aarav to place each date and explain the order.
